images.caption: Figure 2: Shows the entire information flow of Persona-Aware D2S-Model Pipeline. Initially, LLM for Topic Generator is trained with supervision from Persona-Aware D2S dataset, followed by finetuning using human- feedback to produce Fine-tuned LM for Topic Generator. For each generated slide outline, we filter content from document to extract relevant snippet for the title, the final content generator LLM is fine-tuned with Human Feedback. The content for all slide outlines are summarized and aligned to produce a logically coherent slide deck.
